verdict.rationale: Companies House publishes a documented public RESTful API for live register data, with a get-started guide, Authorisation, Rate limiting and Versioning guides, and a Developer Forum. A probe confirmed a real endpoint that returns a structured auth challenge, consistent with free registered API keys. The documented API covers retrieving register data; the write-side services (filing accounts, changing the registered office, ordering certificates) are only evidenced as web services. Missing for 10: evidence that filing and other write actions can be done through the API, a stable versioned API (resources are held 'as is' at beta version 0), and agent-oriented docs (no llms.txt found).
